# Code of conduct

Participants should treat one another with respect, welcome questions and differing experience levels, and give specific, constructive feedback. Discuss code and behavior without personal attacks.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, unwanted sexual attention, doxxing, and publication of private information are not acceptable in project spaces or when representing this project.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful contributions and temporarily or permanently restrict participation. Responses should be proportionate, explain the relevant conduct, and protect the privacy of affected people.

To report a conduct concern, request a private maintainer contact through the [support channel](SUPPORT.md) without posting incident details. Share sensitive information only in the resulting private conversation.
